DuplicateRule.alertText: A Salesforce account with this Tax ID already exists. Check for an existing record before creating a new account.
DuplicateRule.description: Blocks Account save when Tax_ID__c matches an existing Account record. NullNotAllowed on the matching rule ensures blank Tax IDs are never flagged as duplicates. SDD §Account - Duplicate check on Tax ID at Account level. G-01.
